card.name: Inside capitalized words in boxed warnings
card.fires_on: Partway through long all-capital words in boxed warning headings, such as HYPOTENSION, ACETAMINOPHEN, MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION and PREGNANT. It fires on the piece just before the word is completed.

modes.label: Inside capitalized medical terms
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps condition or drug name in a warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: SEVERE NEUTROPENIA; ORTHOSTATIC H<<YP>>OTENSION, BRADYCARDIA

modes.label: Start of a capitalized word after IN
modes.description: The first piece of an all-caps word such as PREGNANT or PEDIATRIC that follows the word IN.
modes.example: OF PROMETHAZINE HYDROCHLORIDE BE USED IN<< P>>EDIATRIC PATIENTS 2

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand name written in capitals or mixed case.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with words that begin with IN, and away from NOT and NOTE.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long capitalized word in a boxed warning, where the word is still unfinished.
